title: P256 ping-pong prefix banks in main loop

claims.statement: For the protected full-production P256 target, the complete cold classical algorithm in proof.md and supporting documents recovers the scalar with probability at least0.39 using at most98393133055132779259040042564463273967616 scalar instruction equivalents, below2^126.209897142931436 group units at C1000. q1=377468911,q2=2^28,N=2^70. Includes all construction, normalization, range-tree control, capped carry/failure costs, fixed block-window transport with transaction-bound ACK events, grouping, explicit resolution, verification and output. Peak memory below2^136bytes; preprocessing below2^118units included; no advice or auxiliary powers. Analytical bound under the stated ideal-coin and blocking-port machine, not production execution or formal certification. Chains the forward prefix through alternating register banks on main items (441/4 fwd plus pinned-tail premium in fixed, 2533/4 fused bwd); 5481 fixed per row.

experiments.purpose: Check direction/carry-specialized assembly and descriptor invariants.
